items.q: One thing was because of the people you named, the Hodges and Carney, who they were written for

ctx.x: One thing was because of the people you named, the Hodges and Carney, who they were written for, it was what those people were at the time it was done. Their whole lifestyle, everything around them, the way they dressed, the food they ate, how they procured that food, what it really felt like to be a part of the society of say, 1936. It was another world and we can't possibly know that.
